ops.title: Trunk queue membership is not bound to its indexed head
ops.body:
Trunk's [v2 PR schema](https://docs.trunk.io/merge-queue/reference/api-v2/pullrequests/get-a-pull-request.md) describes `sha` as the last indexed head used to compare verification runs. Queue membership comes from `isCurrentlySubmittedToQueue` and queue-entry state; the schema does not bind membership to `sha`.

Keep authoritative membership semantics. Do not require indexed-head equality before restacking without a demonstrated contract gap. The unused candidate was removed; no production behavior changed.
